description: Report a bug, a missing feature, a wrong answer or unclear docs in Mudpie’s agent tools, right when you hit it. Only kind and message are required. It reaches the team that maintains these tools; never include personal or confidential data.

examples.expected: A date filter on search results.
examples.message: mudpie_search cannot limit results to pages updated in the last year.

client.description: The application or client sending this, not the underlying model, e.g. Cursor. Null when unknown.

expected.description: What you expected or needed instead. Null when not applicable.

kind.description: bug: a tool failed or behaved unexpectedly. missing_feature: a tool, field or capability you needed does not exist. wrong_answer: a result was inaccurate or unsupported. docs: documentation or a schema was unclear. other: anything else.

message.description: What happened or what is missing, specifically enough to act on.

operation_id.description: The operation_id or attempt_id of the response this is about. Null when none.

tool.description: The tool name or HTTP operation this is about. Null when general.

name: mudpie_feedback
